market.title: Market
market.description: TradingView market to screen. Common values: america, crypto, forex, india, uk, germany, canada, australia, japan.

marketCapMin.title: Min market cap (USD)
marketCapMin.description: Only return symbols with market cap at or above this value.

marketCapMax.title: Max market cap (USD)
marketCapMax.description: Only return symbols with market cap at or below this value.

priceMin.title: Min price
priceMin.description: Only return symbols trading at or above this price.

priceMax.title: Max price
priceMax.description: Only return symbols trading at or below this price.

volumeMin.title: Min daily volume
volumeMin.description: Only return symbols with daily volume at or above this value.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Restrict to these TradingView sectors, e.g. "Technology Services", "Electronic Technology", "Finance", "Health Technology", "Energy Minerals".

peRatioMin.title: Min P/E ratio
peRatioMin.description: Only return symbols with trailing P/E at or above this value.

peRatioMax.title: Max P/E ratio
peRatioMax.description: Only return symbols with trailing P/E at or below this value.

dividendYieldMin.title: Min dividend yield (%)
dividendYieldMin.description: Only return symbols with a dividend yield at or above this percent.

rsiMin.title: Min RSI
rsiMin.description: Only return symbols with 14-period RSI at or above this value (e.g. 70 for overbought).

rsiMax.title: Max RSI
rsiMax.description: Only return symbols with 14-period RSI at or below this value (e.g. 30 for oversold).

changeMin.title: Min daily change (%)
changeMin.description: Only return symbols up at least this percent on the day.

filters.title: Raw filters (advanced)
filters.description: Power-user passthrough of raw TradingView filter objects, each { "left": "<field>", "operation": "<op>", "right": <value> }. Appended to the filters built above.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: TradingView column to sort by, e.g. market_cap_basic, volume, change, dividend_yield_recent, RSI.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of rows to return across all pages. First 25 rows per run are free.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The scanner is a tolerant public API, so proxy is off by default. Supply one only if you run very large pulls and hit rate limits.
